answer_text: Sorry for the recurring disconnections at Chicago. The KB notes a known issue where applying a hub-and-spoke configuration to the Socket site infrastructure can cause degraded network states and Socket disconnects/restarts. This has been addressed in the v23.0 releases; upgrading to v23.0.19445 or v23.0.19786 (or newer) resolves the problem for affected sites. If you’re not on one of these builds yet, plan an upgrade to a patched release and re-test the Chicago site.
